kpis.description_fr: Valeur comptable par action (book value) - KPI signature mortgage REIT, déterminant pour valorisation P/B.
kpis.description_en: Common book value per share - signature mortgage REIT KPI driving P/B valuation.

kpis.description_fr: Effet de levier économique (recourse debt + TBA + net forwards / equity). Target <10x. Annaly maintient sous 7x depuis COVID.
kpis.description_en: Economic leverage (recourse debt + TBA + net forwards / equity). Target <10x. Annaly has kept below 7x since COVID.

kpis.description_fr: Net Interest Margin hors Premium Amortization Adj. - KPI fondamental mREIT, écart entre rendement actifs MBS et coût du repo.
kpis.description_en: NIM excluding Premium Amortization Adj. - core mREIT KPI = MBS yield minus repo cost.

kpis.name_fr: Earnings Available for Distribution par action
kpis.description_fr: Earnings Available for Distribution par action - mesure du dividende potentiel récurrent, alternative à EPS pour mREIT.
kpis.description_en: EAD per share - sustainable dividend capacity metric, mREIT-specific alternative to EPS.

kpis.description_fr: Allocation capital Agency MBS (62% capital / 89% assets). Residential Credit 19%, MSR 19%.
kpis.description_en: Capital allocation to Agency MBS (62% of capital / 89% of assets). Residential Credit 19%, MSR 19%.

kpis.description_fr: Rendement EAD annualisé sur capitaux propres moyens, hors PAA. Mesure de rentabilité économique mREIT.
kpis.description_en: Annualized EAD return on average equity (ex-PAA). Economic profitability metric for mREIT.

_notes: Strong mREIT-specific disclosure. Annaly 3 sleeves: Agency MBS (62% capital), Residential Credit (19%), MSR (19%). All KPIs are sector-standard for mortgage REITs.
